title: pkg install spends about 7 s in two full package status queries
description: Observed 2026-11-17 on Mark's Mac (mise 2026.11.9, about 120 declared bootstrap packages): `mise -C ~ bootstrap packages status --json` takes 3.4 s. `pkg install` of any bootstrap package runs it twice, once before installing and once after (crates/pkg-core/src/install.rs, States::load), so every install waits about 6.8 s on status alone, however small the package; `pkg install brew:hello --dry-run` takes 5.6 s in total. upgrade and sync run the same query before and after as well. Expected: the wait scales with what was asked for. Ideas, none verified: ask mise for the named packages only if a narrower query exists, or reuse the first answer for packages the command did not touch. Found while grounding proposal 0003 (progress display, PR #3). Out of scope there: that proposal shows a step and elapsed time during these waits but does not shorten them.

title: Installs that need sudo cannot ask for a password under pkg
description: Expected: `pkg install brew-cask:<cask>` for a cask whose installer needs root can obtain elevation when a person runs it in a terminal. Actual (inferred from mise 2026.11.9 source, not reproduced): pkg pipes mise's stderr (crates/pkg-core/src/mise/mod.rs, Mise::run), and mise chooses interactive elevation only when its own stderr is a terminal (crates/mise-ui/src/sudo.rs: subprocess_mode and ensure_elevation_available use console::user_attended_stderr). Under pkg mise therefore runs `sudo -n true` and fails fast unless sudo credentials are already cached. Repro to confirm: in a terminal with no cached sudo timestamp (`sudo -k`), run pkg install for a cask with a pkg installer and compare with running the same `mise -C ~ bootstrap packages use --yes -g` directly. Workaround: run `sudo -v` first. Found while grounding proposal 0003 (progress display, PR #3). Out of scope there: that proposal keeps mise piped and does not change elevation; proposal 0002 (first-machine bootstrap, PR #2) permits terminal interaction for `pkg bootstrap` only.
